note: Phase 14: the printer is the reader's inverse, through kg's own writer. A name that would read back as something else escapes; `.emacs` would not, and does not. Deliberately NOT spelled through `(format "%S" ...)`, which would put the escaped name inside a printed STRING: kg's writer does not escape a backslash inside a string, so `"a\ b"` prints as it is and Emacs prints `"a\\ b"` -- a pre-existing gap this phase surfaced and doc/TODO.md now records, not a symbol question.
